title: Threshold and rule registry
description: Single source of truth for the numeric knobs that turn a value into a status. Collection recipes reference a rule by name. 'high'/'low' rules are applied directly by apply_rule(); 'params' rules carry arbitrary knobs read by a named adapter that owns its own (sustained-window / correlation) logic.

kind.description: high: larger is worse. low: smaller is worse. params: knobs only, interpreted by a named adapter.

critical.description: Optional. Omit to never escalate to CRITICAL.

serves.description: Check IDs this rule informs; documentation only.
